name: Ira Design · IRA Design

title.zh: Ira Design · 按人物、物体和背景挑选手绘风

description.zh: 看Characters中已经渲染的人物插画细节，与背景页区分。 IRA Design是Creative Tim的手绘风插画库，提供人物、物体、背景及渐变配色入口。官方资产仓库按MIT许可免费提供插画，PNG与SVG下载链接见原README，使用时须保留版权和许可通知。
description.en: IRA Design by Creative Tim provides hand-drawn characters, objects and backgrounds, with gradient controls on its website. Its official illustration assets are free under the MIT license. The original asset README links PNG and SVG packages. Copyright and permission notices must be retained; the asset license does not establish a license for every website file.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Ira Design (https://iradesign.io/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看Characters中已经渲染的人物插画细节，与背景页区分。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在首页看到人物场景、部件渐变选项及Colored、Outline入口。背景页露出星空、沙发房间和车站三种预览，下缘有裁切；人物页展示三种紫衣人物姿态。图片只证明当前已呈现的素材，未实测换色或下载。资产仓库README列PNG、SVG包，MIT要求保留版权和许可；课程广告、其他付费产品及整站程序许可另算。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
